plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for RACOM RipEX2 radio modems and M!DGE3 cellular routers (RACOM-RA2-MIB, enterprise PEN 33555). It reports uptime, CPU, modem and radio board temperatures, supply input voltage, and interface traffic.
name: Router

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: CPU temperature of the RACOM RipEX2 / M!DGE3 router in degrees Celsius, from cpuTemperature (RACOM-RA2-MIB, 1.3.6.1.4.1.33555.3.1.4.3.0, 0.1 degree units, divided by 10). Raw values outside -500 to 1500 are dropped.

metrics.name: modem_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Modem board temperature of the RACOM RipEX2 / M!DGE3 router in degrees Celsius, from modemTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.33555.3.1.4.2.0, 0.1 degree units, divided by 10).

metrics.name: radio_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Radio board temperature of the RACOM RipEX2 / M!DGE3 router in degrees Celsius, from radioTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.33555.3.1.4.1.0, 0.1 degree units, divided by 10). Cellular-only M!DGE3 units without a primary radio may not expose this object, so the series is absent on them.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Supply input voltage of the RACOM RipEX2 / M!DGE3 router in volts, from inputVoltage (1.3.6.1.4.1.33555.3.1.4.4.0, 0.1 V units, divided by 10). A raw value of 0 is treated as not measured and dropped.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
